question: Which of the following trees is NOT found in the tropical evergreen forests of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amaltas**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amaltas** is not found in the tropical evergreen forests of India.
 
• Tropical evergreen forests are characterized by dense, multi-layered vegetation and are found in regions with heavy rainfall.
 
• Common trees in these forests include **Ebony, Mahogany, and Rosewood**.
 
• **Amaltas**, also known as the Golden Shower tree, is typically found in deciduous forests and is known for its bright yellow flowers.
 
• The tropical evergreen forests are crucial for maintaining ecological balance and supporting a wide variety of wildlife.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India's tropical evergreen forests are primarily located in the states of Kerala, Karnataka, and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• These forests play a significant role in the global carbon cycle by absorbing large amounts of carbon dioxide.
 
• They are also home to numerous endemic species of plants and animals, many of which are not found anywhere else in the world.
 
• Conservation efforts are crucial to protect these forests from deforestation and other environmental threats.
